motion: The camera does not move. The clean, still air stays clear: no smoke, no steam, no mist. The warm golden light in the narrow doorway slowly grows brighter and spills further out across the pale step and the mud. The small grey robot with the torn bunting turns a little to its left, rolls slowly onto the pale step, tips up over its edge and rolls on into the light of the doorway, until only its amber beacon shows in the glow. The people standing behind it stay still, watching it go. The camera does not move.
